newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stock index sets yet another high at close.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stock index sets yet another high at close.

text.p: Madrid's general stock index smashed the another all-time high at the close of trade on Friday, adding 5.83 points, or 1.11 percent, to 531.68.
The previous high was set yesterday, when the index ended at 525.85.
The Ibex-35 blue chip index rose 1.04 percent, to its all-time high of 6,128.07.
The bourse is being buoyed by expectations of good economic data and further rate cuts in Spain, and consequently strong demand from retail investors for shares, dealers said.
